recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片羽狀邊緣出現遠大於周圍紅血球的巨大細胞，胞質豐富、細胞核偏心且呈顆粒狀（C、E 圖），加上 buffy coat 切片中具核內包涵體的巨大細胞（D 圖），在嚴重免疫抑制病人應想到循環中的 CMV 感染細胞（cytomegalic cells）。
features: Very large cells (several times the diameter of adjacent red cells) at the feathered edge of the smear
Single eccentric oval nucleus with coarse granular chromatin, suggestive of nuclear inclusion (panels C and E)
Abundant cytoplasm, pale-staining in panels B-C and pale lilac in panel E, with irregular scalloped cell border
Low-power view (panel A) shows the large cells trapped in the thin feathered edge, easily overlooked on routine scanning
Cell block of buffy coat (panel D) shows an enlarged cell with a large intranuclear inclusion and perinuclear clearing (owl's-eye-like)
Pale, faded staining in panels A-D limits assessment of cytoplasmic granules
describe_en: Composite figure: panels A, B, C and E are peripheral blood smears and panel D is a cell block of the buffy coat. At low power (A), rare very large cells are concentrated at the feathered edge; at high power (B, C, E) these cells measure several times the size of adjacent erythrocytes and have abundant cytoplasm with an irregular border and a single eccentric oval nucleus with coarse, granular chromatin suggestive of an inclusion. The buffy coat cell block (D) shows an isolated enlarged cell with an intranuclear inclusion surrounded by a clear halo. The staining in several panels is faded, limiting evaluation of cytoplasmic granularity. In an immunocompromised patient, findings are consistent with circulating cytomegalovirus-infected (cytomegalic, likely endothelial) cells, supported by CMV DNA detection.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have multilobated or naked hyperchromatic nuclei with platelet-type granular cytoplasm, whereas these cells have a single oval nucleus containing an inclusion; CD61 or CMV IHC/PCR resolves difficult cases.

ddx.dx: Circulating carcinoma or other malignant cells
ddx.vs: Tumor cells usually occur in cohesive clusters with high N:C ratio and prominent nucleoli rather than solitary cells with a single large intranuclear viral inclusion.

ddx.dx: Endothelial cells or squamous contaminants from venipuncture
ddx.vs: Contaminating endothelial or squamous cells are flat with small bland nuclei and no nuclear inclusion or cytomegaly.
